claims: The hippocampus is a region critical for memory.
Many studies suggest metformin can improve cognitive function in patients with type 2 diabetes.
Many studies suggest metformin can enhance executive function in patients with type 2 diabetes.
Many studies suggest metformin can reduce the risk of dementia in patients with type 2 diabetes.
National Institutes of Health say some studies suggest that long-term, high-dose metformin use might lead to impaired cognitive performance.
National Institutes of Health note metformin affects cerebral metabolism.
National Institutes of Health note studies show metformin influences energy metabolism in the hippocampus.
National Institutes of Health note metformin alters metabolism in white matter.
Metformin can act directly in the hypothalamus to help lower blood sugar levels.
ScienceDirect.com notes research indicates that metformin may promote neurogenesis.
ScienceDirect.com notes research indicates that metformin may reduce neuroinflammation.
Intranasal insulin is being studied to improve cognitive function in Alzheimer's disease patients.
National Institutes of Health state GLP-1 analogs show promise in protecting against neurodegeneration beyond just managing blood sugar.
Diabetes UK notes metformin is often referred to as a "friend" for its potential cognitive benefits.
Diabetes UK notes metformin's influence on brain chemistry might have detrimental effects in some circumstances.
